Rafael Costa has consistently delivered reliable, results-oriented engineering solutions at VitalCare Health. His work on ETL pipelines transformed how patient data is ingested, reducing processing latency by 30% during critical reporting cycles. He designed Snowflake-based data warehouses that support real-time analytics for clinical teams, enabling faster decision-making. His ability to balance complexity with clarity—such as simplifying Kafka stream architectures for cross-team integration—has minimized bottlenecks in our data infrastructure.  

Rafael’s soft skills are equally strong. He collaborates seamlessly with product and clinical teams, translating ambiguous requirements into robust data workflows. His proactive approach to troubleshooting—like resolving a Kafka offset misalignment during a system upgrade—prevented potential downtime. He also mentors junior engineers, fostering a culture of shared ownership in our data operations.  

His contributions have directly shaped VitalCare’s operational efficiency. By optimizing Spark jobs for batch processing, he freed up 20% of engineering bandwidth for innovation. His work ensures data reliability, which is critical for our healthtech mission.  

Rafael is a pragmatic problem-solver with a knack for turning technical challenges into scalable solutions. His dedication to precision and teamwork makes him a valuable asset. I’m confident he will bring the same rigor and collaboration to any role he pursues.
